name: Divination
overview: Scripture clearly condemns divination as an abominable practice forbidden to the Israelites, associating it with familiar spirits, wizards, and enchantments that defile God's people (Leviticus 19:26, 19:31). Those who engage in such practices are warned of severe judgment, including being cut off or put to death, reflecting God's strong opposition to turning after these abominations (Leviticus 20:6, 20:27; Deuteronomy 18:9). Prophets, diviners, dreamers, and enchanters who mislead the people are likewise rejected, as their counsel is contrary to trusting in the Lord (Jeremiah 27:9). Ultimately, God frustrates the efforts of diviners and protects His people from harm through these false practices.
